kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Ultimately from the Phoenician letter 𐤁 (bet).
g: The dotless bāʾ is a letter of the Arabic alphabet that was used in ancient Arabic. It is the common archaic form of ب (b, “bāʔ”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Ultimately from the Phoenician letter 𐤕 (t, “taw”).
g: The dotless tāʾ is a letter of the Arabic alphabet that was used in ancient Arabic. It is the common archaic form of ت (t) and ث (ṯ).
